title: RESTEasy Reactive: `valueOf` parameter converters don't work
body:
Just tried this:

```java
class ValueOf {
    String value;
    private ValueOf(String value) {
        this.value = value;
    }
    public static ValueOf valueOf(String value) {
        return new ValueOf(value);
    }
}

@Path("")
public class Endpoint {

    @Path("{valueOf}")
    @GET
    public String convertions(ValueOf valueOf){
        return valueOf;
    }
}
```
